name: Highriskify Hosted Checkout Gateway
author: highriskify

sections.description:
Built for High-Risk and Global Ecommerce

For setup help, merchant support, custom integrations, or white-label inquiries, contact Highriskify on Telegram: https://t.me/HR_Gateway

Accept debit card, credit card, Apple Pay, and bank transfer payments, and receive USDC crypto settlement through a hosted checkout designed for online merchants, high-risk businesses, and global commerce.

Highriskify allows merchants to accept payments using a secure hosted checkout while synchronizing order status automatically back to WooCommerce.

Highriskify may charge a minimal service fee per completed transaction. Fees may vary depending on provider, region, payment method, and merchant configuration.

Features include hosted checkout, USDC settlement options, global payment routing, instant payment notifications, and support for multiple payment providers.

Why Choose Highriskify?

  • Built for high-risk and hard-to-place merchants
  • Hosted multi-payment-provider smart routing checkout
  • Instant USDC crypto settlement options for completed sales
  • Crypto settlement helps reduce traditional card chargeback exposure after payment confirmation
  • Global merchant support
  • Automatic WooCommerce order updates
  • API available for custom integrations
  • White-label opportunities available
  • Designed for scaling businesses
  • No coding required
  • Simple setup: install the plugin, add your wallet address, and start routing card-to-crypto checkout payments

Included Payment Methods

  • Multiple Processor Smart Router — the main Highriskify hosted checkout option for routing customers through available payment providers and synchronizing payment status back to WooCommerce.
  • Interac Online Payments (Canada Only) — a separate WooCommerce payment method. Enable this option if you wish to accept Interac payments from Canadian customers where available.
  • Coinbase for Chase Bank Cards — a separate WooCommerce payment method. Enable this option to route customers using Chase Bank-issued cards through Coinbase, as Coinbase is currently the supported provider path for Chase card payments.

Industries Supported

  • Supplements
  • Nutraceuticals
  • Peptides
  • Telehealth
  • Digital Products
  • SaaS
  • CBD
  • International Ecommerce
  • High-Risk Merchants
  • General Ecommerce

Main features

  • Hosted checkout payment flow for WooCommerce.
  • Separate WooCommerce payment methods for Smart Router, Interac Online Payments, and Coinbase for Chase Bank Cards.
  • Always redirects payment sessions to checkout.highriskify.com.
  • Hosted checkout domain is fixed and hidden from the WooCommerce settings screen.
  • Merchant payout wallet setting for USDC/crypto settlement workflows.
  • WooCommerce callback endpoint for automatic order status updates.
  • Optional operational payment tracking for support and pending-payment troubleshooting. This optional tracking is disabled by default and must be enabled by the merchant.
  • Custom payment method icon/logo support through assets/images/paymentlogo.png or a configured icon URL.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce checkout blocks and High Performance Order Storage.

External services

This plugin connects to Highriskify services to create hosted checkout sessions, generate wallet/session references, redirect customers to hosted checkout, convert store currency when needed, check supported crypto price information when needed, receive payment callback data, and optionally send non-personal operational payment events to the Highriskify dashboard when the merchant enables optional tracking.

The plugin does not include customer name, customer email, customer phone number, billing address, shipping address, product names, SKUs, product IDs, or line-item details in the hosted checkout redirect or optional operational tracking payload. Historical order backfill is disabled in this WordPress.org build.

Highriskify service information:

  • Website: https://highriskify.com/
  • Telegram Support: https://t.me/HR_Gateway
  • Privacy Policy: https://highriskify.com/privacy-policy/
  • Terms of Use: https://highriskify.com/terms-of-use/

Merchants are responsible for reviewing Highriskify terms, privacy policy, provider availability, regional availability, payment method availability, merchant eligibility, and supported business rules before enabling the gateway.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/highriskify-hosted-checkout-gateway/, or install the ZIP file through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate Highriskify Hosted Checkout Gateway.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Payments.
  4. Enable the payment method you want to use: Multiple Processor Smart Router, Interac Online Payments (Canada Only), or Coinbase for Chase Bank Cards.
  5. Add your payout wallet address. The hosted checkout domain is fixed to checkout.highriskify.com and is not editable from the settings screen.
  6. Save settings and place a small test order.
sections.faq:
Who can use Highriskify?

Highriskify is designed for WooCommerce merchants seeking additional payment options, including businesses operating internationally or in industries that may require specialized payment solutions.

How can I contact Highriskify support?

For setup help, merchant support, custom integration questions, or white-label inquiries, contact Highriskify on Telegram: https://t.me/HR_Gateway

What is the Multiple Processor Smart Router?

Multiple Processor Smart Router is the main Highriskify hosted checkout method. It routes customers through available payment providers where supported and synchronizes payment status back to WooCommerce.

What is Interac Online Payments?

Interac Online Payments is a separate WooCommerce payment method for Canadian customers where Interac payment routing is available.

What is Coinbase for Chase Bank Cards?

Coinbase for Chase Bank Cards is a separate WooCommerce payment method intended to route customers using Chase Bank-issued cards through Coinbase where supported.

Do I need coding skills to use the plugin?

No. Installation is similar to most WooCommerce payment gateways. Install the plugin, add your USDC wallet address, enable the gateway, and start accepting payments through the hosted checkout.

Does Highriskify automatically update WooCommerce orders?

Yes. Once a payment has been successfully completed and confirmed, Highriskify synchronizes the transaction status with WooCommerce and updates the corresponding order.

Can I use my own branding?

Yes. Merchants may customize their checkout experience with their own logo and branding elements, depending on the selected checkout configuration.

Can I use my own domain for checkout?

Yes. Custom domain support is available for merchants who wish to provide a branded payment experience for their customers.

What payment methods are available?

Available payment methods depend on the enabled providers, merchant location, customer location, and regional availability.

Supported payment options may include cards, bank transfers, digital wallets, Apple Pay, Stripe, PayPal, Interac, Coinbase, and other supported providers where available.

Does Highriskify charge fees?

Highriskify may charge a minimal service fee per completed transaction. Fees may vary depending on provider, region, payment method, and merchant configuration.

How are payouts handled?

Settlement is available in USDC crypto after completed transactions. Payouts are sent to the merchant’s configured non-custodial wallet according to the selected checkout and provider configuration.

Is customer information stored by the plugin?

The plugin only processes the information necessary to complete and synchronize transactions with WooCommerce.

Optional analytics and reporting features can be enabled or disabled by the merchant. Please review the Highriskify Privacy Policy for complete details.

Is Highriskify suitable for international merchants?

Yes. Highriskify is built to support global commerce. Customers can pay through available checkout methods, and merchants may receive USDC crypto settlement depending on the selected configuration.

Can developers integrate Highriskify into custom applications?

Yes. In addition to WooCommerce integration, API capabilities are available for developers requiring custom checkout flows or external platform integrations.

Is merchant account sign up required?

The plugin is designed for simple setup. Install the plugin, add your wallet address, enable the gateway, and configure the available checkout options to begin routing payments through Highriskify.
sections.changelog:
1.0.11

  • Updated readme description, Telegram support details, fee disclosure, and payment method formatting.

1.0.10

  • Removed advanced styling and fee tolerance settings from secondary Interac and Coinbase gateway settings screens.

1.0.9

  • Added separate WooCommerce payment methods for Interac Online Payments and Coinbase for Chase Bank Cards.

1.0.8

  • Added smart router wording, provider routing options, Telegram support, and updated readme content.

1.0.7

  • Updated WordPress.org listing description, tags, and FAQ content.

1.0.6

  • Added the public Highriskify Privacy Policy and Terms of Use URLs to the external service disclosure.

1.0.5

  • Removed runtime gateway settings overwrite behavior so merchant-configured checkout title and description are respected.
  • Updated external service disclosure to avoid invalid 404 legal URLs.

1.0.4

  • Removed Plugin URI header so it is not the same as Author URI.

1.0.3

  • Renamed the plugin to Highriskify Hosted Checkout Gateway and changed the text domain/slug to avoid restricted naming terms.
  • Removed WordPress.org directory-only banner, icon, and screenshot files from the plugin ZIP.
  • Made optional operational dashboard tracking disabled by default.
  • Added detailed external service disclosure.
  • Kept hosted checkout as the only included payment gateway option.

1.0.2

  • Updated default checkout title and description.
  • Updated migration behavior for safer hosted checkout defaults.

1.0.1

  • Fixed hosted checkout domain to checkout.highriskify.com and hid the domain field from gateway settings.
  • Removed customer/product data from tracking payloads.
  • Disabled silent historical order backfill so old orders are not sent automatically.

1.0.0

  • Initial Highriskify branded hosted checkout release.
